source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 2 Grammar in Use:宾语从句(复习)。三点:that 引导陈述宾语从句、if/whether 引导一般疑问的转述、连接代词/副词引导特殊疑问宾语从句(陈述语序+时态呼应)。句子地道、零术语、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)、围绕志愿服务主题。

points.point: that 引导陈述宾语从句(think/know/believe/hope (that) ...)
points.overview: think/know/believe/hope/say/find 等动词后接陈述内容时,用连接词 that 引导宾语从句(口语中常省略),从句用陈述语序;不可用 if/what/whether 等引导一个完整的陈述。

points.point: if / whether 引导一般疑问的转述(ask/wonder/want to know ...)
points.overview: 把一个一般疑问句(Yes/No 问题)变成宾语从句时,用 if 或 whether 引导,从句改为陈述语序(主语在前、谓语在后);ask/wonder/want to know 等后接是否类内容时不用 that/what。

points.point: 连接代词/副词引导特殊疑问宾语从句(陈述语序 + 时态呼应)
points.overview: 把特殊疑问句变成宾语从句时,保留疑问词 what/who/whom/where/when/why/how,从句改为陈述语序;主句为过去时,从句一般也用相应的过去时。

questions.stem: Max believes ____ volunteering can change a young person's whole life.
questions.explanation: believe 后接一个完整的陈述内容(志愿服务能改变人生),用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: I really hope ____ more students will join our recycling campaign this year.
questions.explanation: hope 后是对未来的陈述,用 that(可省略);不能用表示是否的 if/whether。

questions.stem: The twins know ____ their website helps children find volunteer work.
questions.explanation: know 后是一句陈述(网站帮孩子找志愿工作),用 that 引导。

questions.stem: Jackson says ____ reusable bottles can cut down a lot of plastic waste.
questions.explanation: say 后接陈述内容,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: Many people think ____ young volunteers can truly make a difference.
questions.explanation: think 后是陈述(年轻志愿者能带来改变),用 that。

questions.stem: Xiao Meng found ____ every brick in the palace seemed to tell a story.
questions.explanation: find 后接陈述发现,用 that 引导;不能用 if/whether。

questions.stem: We all agreed ____ the animal shelter needed more weekend helpers.
questions.explanation: agree 后接一致意见的陈述,用 that 引导。

questions.stem: The teacher explained ____ volunteering teaches us to value what we have.
questions.explanation: explain 后接陈述内容,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: Joris believes ____ even a child can help protect endangered animals.
questions.explanation: believe 后是陈述(孩子也能帮助保护动物),用 that。

questions.stem: She realised ____ doing research first would have saved a lot of trouble.
questions.explanation: realise 后接陈述领悟,用 that 引导;非是否问题。

questions.stem: I promise ____ I will spend every Saturday morning at the shelter.
questions.explanation: promise 后接承诺的陈述,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: Pippa admitted ____ the group had failed at the only task they were given.
questions.explanation: admit 后接陈述承认,用 that 引导;不能用 if/whether。

questions.stem: Everyone hopes ____ the new campaign will reach the whole town soon.
questions.explanation: hope 后接对未来的陈述,用 that 引导。

questions.stem: The volunteers learned ____ small daily efforts can add up to real change.
questions.explanation: learn 后接陈述所得,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: He noticed ____ the local men quietly rebuilt the library every night.
questions.explanation: notice 后接陈述发现,用 that 引导;非是否或疑问内容。

questions.stem: The article points out ____ good intentions alone are not always enough.
questions.explanation: point out 后接陈述观点,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: I feel ____ helping others also makes the helper happier in the end.
questions.explanation: feel 后接陈述感受(可省 that),用 that 引导;不能用 if/whether/what。

questions.stem: The guide added ____ twenty-five emperors had once lived in the palace.
questions.explanation: add 后接补充的陈述,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: Our team is sure ____ reusable bottles will become popular before long.
questions.explanation: be sure 后接陈述把握,用 that 引导;非是否问题。

questions.stem: Volunteers often say ____ giving their time is far more rewarding than money.
questions.explanation: say 后接陈述内容,用 that 引导陈述宾语从句。

questions.stem: The interviewer asked Xu Yuan ____ she had any volunteer experience before.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述一个一般疑问(有没有经验),用 if 引导,从句陈述语序;不能用 that。

questions.stem: I wonder ____ the animal shelter still needs helpers this weekend.
questions.explanation: wonder 后转述是否类问题,用 whether(= if)引导,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: She wanted to know ____ her attendance at the expo would be recorded.
questions.explanation: want to know 后转述 Yes/No 问题(会不会被记录),用 if 引导。

questions.stem: Jackson asked the restaurant owners ____ they would sell paper bottles.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述一般疑问(愿不愿意卖),用 whether 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: The boys did not know ____ the website would attract any visitors at all.
questions.explanation: know(否定)后转述是否问题,选项中只有 whether 成立(that/what/who 均不引导是否类转述)。

questions.stem: Please tell me ____ the charity accepts second-hand clothes as donations.
questions.explanation: tell 后转述 Yes/No 问题(收不收旧衣),用 if 引导。

questions.stem: Jiang was not sure ____ all the food at the expo could be traced to its source.
questions.explanation: be sure(否定)后转述是否问题,用 whether 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: He wondered ____ his small donation could really help the shelter at all.
questions.explanation: wonder 后转述是否问题(能不能帮上),用 if 引导。

questions.stem: The students asked ____ the orphanage really needed a new library.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述 Yes/No 问题(是否真的需要),用 whether 引导。

questions.stem: I'd like to find out ____ the march has been approved by the county yet.
questions.explanation: find out 后转述是否问题(有没有获批),用 if 引导。

questions.stem: She asked the guide ____ ordinary visitors could join the tour for free.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述一般疑问(能否免费参加),用 whether 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: We are not certain ____ the campaign has changed people's daily habits.
questions.explanation: be certain(否定)后转述是否问题,用 whether 引导。

questions.stem: He asked the officials ____ a short haircut was required for every girl.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述 Yes/No 问题(是否要求短发),用 if 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: I wonder ____ the two boys planned the whole project on their own.
questions.explanation: wonder 后转述是否问题(是否独立完成),用 whether 引导。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ____ the volunteer fair will be held this December?
questions.explanation: tell 后转述 Yes/No 问题(是否举办),用 if 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us ____ we had ever donated to a charity before.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述是否问题(有没有捐过),用 whether 引导。

questions.stem: Pippa wondered ____ her gifts would really be useful to the local girls.
questions.explanation: wonder 后转述是否问题(礼物是否有用),用 if 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: Nobody knew ____ the local men would come back to fix the wall at night.
questions.explanation: know(否定)后转述是否问题,用 whether 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: She asked the leader ____ new volunteers needed any special training first.
questions.explanation: ask 后转述 Yes/No 问题(是否需要培训),用 if 引导。

questions.stem: I'm wondering ____ our paper bottles can really replace plastic ones.
questions.explanation: wonder 后转述是否问题(能否替代),用 whether 引导,陈述语序。

questions.stem: At the interview she asked me ____ my greatest strength was.
questions.explanation: 转述特殊疑问 'What is your greatest strength?',保留 what,从句用陈述语序 what my strength was。

questions.stem: The leader explained ____ we should report to after the interview.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Whom should you report to?',保留 whom,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: Jiang was told ____ she would work during the import expo.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Where will you work?',保留 where,从句陈述语序 where she would work。

questions.stem: I'd like to know ____ first started this volunteer website.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Who started the website?',who 作从句主语,语序不变。

questions.stem: The interviewer wondered ____ I had organised so many activities.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How did you organise them?',保留 how,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: She wanted to know ____ I would like to serve as a volunteer.
questions.explanation: 转述 'When would you like to serve?',保留 when,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: Nobody could tell us ____ the old guide had remembered every clock.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How did she remember them?',保留 how,主句过去时从句也用过去完成。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us ____ we wanted to help in our community.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Why do you want to help?',保留 why,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: I forget ____ the volunteer fair will be held this year.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Where will it be held?',保留 where,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: He explained ____ his work experience related to the volunteer position.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How does your experience relate?',保留 how,主句过去时从句用过去时 related。

questions.stem: She finally understood ____ her mother had encouraged her to volunteer.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Why did her mother encourage her?',保留 why,主句过去时从句用过去完成。

questions.stem: Please tell me ____ I can sign up for the weekend shelter work.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How can I sign up?',保留 how,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: The girls did not understand ____ the strange hair bands were for.
questions.explanation: 转述 'What are the bands for?',保留 what(介词 for 留在句末),从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: I asked the guide ____ many visitors came to the palace each day.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How many visitors come each day?',保留 how many,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: We were curious about ____ the twins had got their first idea.
questions.explanation: 转述 'Where did they get the idea?',保留 where,主句过去时从句用过去完成。

questions.stem: Can you tell me ____ is in charge of the recycling campaign?
questions.explanation: 转述 'Who is in charge?',who 作从句主语,语序不变。

questions.stem: The officials decided ____ the schoolgirls should wear their hair.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How should the girls wear their hair?',保留 how,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: She showed the new helper ____ she could keep the food safe.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How can I keep the food safe?',保留 how,主句过去时从句用过去时 could。

questions.stem: Then I was supposed to tell her ____ I expected from the position.
questions.explanation: 转述 'What do you expect from the position?',保留 what 作宾语,从句陈述语序。

questions.stem: I really want to find out ____ this strength will help me as a volunteer.
questions.explanation: 转述 'How will this strength help you?',保留 how,从句陈述语序。
